OS1.supports: Proposed interface strips only; real bearings unknown; twin torsion-resistant closed side girders/stiffened box and end diaphragm are a structural concept. No section size assigned.
OS1.units: q kN/m²; line kN/m; reaction kN; moment kN·m
OS1.side_eccentric_action: Wrap gravity first moment about bridge axis requires torsion-resisting section/end frame. Signs reverse on C mirror.
OS1.sensitivity_note: Uniform q, vertical resultant bookkeeping. Does not resolve two support lines into a beam/anchor design, support span is unverified.
missing_calculation_inputs: as-built beam/wall centerlines and sections at three core ends and three slab ends
slab edge supporting collectors and their continuity
anchorage and bearing dimensions and reinforcement
steel/concrete strength and section properties including torsional stiffness
dead loads, pedestrian traffic load and fatigue/serviceability criteria
existing capacity and allowable differential movements
load combinations, wind/seismic movements, fire resistance and connection erection sequence

OS2.reason: OS1 has insufficient evidence, and has not been technically rejected.

OS3.reason: No intermediate support modeled. OS1/OS2 rejection and a separate decision would be required.
